html_description:
Bound by Soft Marks and Harbor Light

THE LEDGER ALREADY HAS HIS NAME. A Quiet List mark. Glass Holding's stamp. Charges written as corporate language for grain diverted to orphanages — theft, by their accounting. What they want: berths, and Julian Kane made invisible if he refuses.

Someone wedged the parchment between the safehouse floorboards while Julian Kane was checking the south jetty. Harbor seal. Quiet List mark. Glass Holding's secondary stamp in the fold.

Elena Voss has six weeks of Glass Holding documentation and thirty days before the mark goes brass. Julian has six months of unauthorized work and the stillness of a man who saw this coming and said nothing.

When protocol becomes a kill order, devotion is the only currency left that doesn't belong to the syndicate. Harbor Light Book Two.

What you will find inside

  • Dark mafia romance — Quiet List marks, Holding paper, berth leverage
  • Slow-burn heat — protocol first, touch later, trust as behavior
  • System as villain — Glass Holding moves faster than knives
  • Harbor Light Book 2 — continue after Bound by Blood
  • HEA with cost — love as the ledger line they refuse to surrender

If you crave dark mafia romance where love costs something real — start reading tonight.

Scroll up and grab your copy.
